prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE game environment base layer image for PipaKlub, a small playable slice of Morro do Sol: entry square and ONE stairway connected to an upper landing. This is not the whole neighborhood, not a concept poster. Use the provided whole-district image only for architectural identity/materials; simplify drastically and use a strictly consistent elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC top-down 2D RPG camera, north up, building facades facing south, no isometric diagonally rotated grid, no horizon/sky, no perspective vanishing point.
Landscape 3:2 composition, intended canvas 1536x1024. Accurate layout important: quiet light sandstone paved entry plaza spans approximately x=240..1280, y=580..900. Main staircase aligned vertically centered at x=896..1088, y=350..580, leading north to upper landing x=704..1312,y=220..350. A substantial continuous grey warm stone retaining wall runs horizontally across y=350..560 on either side of this stair, explaining the elevation change; actual solid wall faces, no stripe of grass pretending to be a floor change. Two modest plaster homes occupy left side and upper-left outside walking area; warm cream/coral walls, terracotta roofs, blue/teal doors, coherent size, doors ~95px high, homes ~300px wide. At upper-right behind landing a small modest house with one blue water tank as landmark. At lower-left edge a low entrance gate opens directly onto plaza. Keep the lower-right plaza clear enough for walking. One small kite-making worktable and a bench tucked against LEFT edge of plaza x~330 y~650, not in center of path. Minimal pots, small flower accents, peripheral shrubs. NO trees with overhanging crowns in this base layer: one tree canopy and its trunk will be separate assets added later at left-front edge. Leave clear space there. No characters, people, creatures or baked actor shadows, no labels, signs, HUD, borders, text or icons.
Art: clean hand-painted 2D outlined chibi-RPG environment, simplified shapes, restrained warm cel shading, fairly flat walkable ground with subtle large worn stone slabs (not noisy repeating tiny tiles). Warm sun upper-left with consistent short shadows. Reduce saturation and foliage density compared to reference. Paths are visually quiet. Objects moderate contrast, door and staircase silhouettes legible. Cohesive constructed scene, not separated sprites. Lower perimeter blends into dry hillside vegetation and footpath without cliff edge around whole square. Maintain continuous unobstructed ground joining plaza to stair base to landing. No additional stairs, no parallel duplicate stairs, no water, no bridges, no rails across walkable stair entrances. This image will be placed as an authored Tiled ground/architecture layer with separate precise collision objects.

Create ONE transparent-background foreground layer for the referenced 1536x1024 PipaKlub plaza environment. Canvas must keep the same landscape 3:2 framing, 1536x1024. The reference image is ONLY for style and coordinates: DO NOT reproduce its buildings, ground, furniture or walls. Draw ONLY a single small leafy shade tree with a visible brown trunk, coherent in the same orthographic top-down RPG camera and clean outlined 2D hand-painted cel shading. Position trunk root/ground contact exactly at approximately x=1232,y=800. Tree crown occupies approximately x=1100..1360,y=530..735, total tree including trunk stays within x=1080..1380,y=520..810. Tree about 280px tall, moderate sage green foliage, quiet broad leaf masses, a few warm accents, clean readable silhouette. Sun from upper-left. Everything outside the tree MUST be actual transparent alpha, no background, no ground, no cast shadow, no people, no text, no borders. Keep the rest of the entire large canvas empty transparent so this layer can be overlaid at (0,0) on the reference map without any scaling or repositioning. This will provide proper foreground occlusion as the player walks behind its crown; do not merge it into a scene.
